summary: 61 x 61 cm face, 80 cm deep: the Titans' grid
12 mm birch shell, 15 mm birch front
Celestion TSQ1845 (8 ohm), tuned about 25 Hz
two triangular ducts behind stepped mouths on one diagonal
about 43 kg with the driver: a two-person lift

notes.text: heavy line: the stepped hole in the front panel, which is drawn see-through here
tooth tips stay square: the Piramide look. Give the hole's front edges a light 6 mm round-over (the wall ends too)

3D-printed wedges (PETG or ASA) in the four pockets, glued to the panel, the walls and the back of the teeth. They carry the steps back, then ease down to the panel over 12 cm, so the air never hits a flat wall
the duct behind: 190 cm2, a third more than the hole
a wedge from the side. 2 per mouth behind the teeth, 2 at the step ends (one mirrored)
